prompts.title: AI Extender for Claude
prompts.description: Describe what you want Claude to do, and AI Extender plans, builds, checks, and packages the skill, plugin, or internal tool for you. Pick a goal, say it in your own words, and approve one plan.
prompts.content:
# AI Extender for Claude

Run /ai-extender and help me with the goal below. Talk to me in plain words. Work out the technical choices yourself and ask only what I alone can answer.

* **Goal:** `{{goal}}`
* **What I want:** `{{request}}`
* **Who will use it:** `{{audience}}`
* **Where they use Claude:** `{{surface}}`
* **Files:** `{{files}}`

If something you need is missing, ask for it in one short message, then continue.

Plan gate: before you build or change anything, show a short plan (what it will do, what you'll make, how it gets installed) and wait for my yes. Checks and audits run without it. Never publish, push, or delete anything without asking first.

When you finish, give me the file, two or three lines on how to install it, and one prompt to try first.

goal.label: Goal
goal.context: Pick the closest one. Build something new covers skills, plugins, connectors, agents, and internal tools for a team. Turn into a skill takes a workflow you already follow, a prompt you keep reusing, or this conversation. Check before sharing runs an audit and changes nothing until you agree. Package or share makes the file to upload or send, or prepares a marketplace.
goal.options:
Build Something New
Turn a Workflow or Prompt Into a Skill
Update or Fix Something I Already Have
Check it Before I Share It
Package or Share It

request.label: What I Want
request.placeholder: Turn my meeting notes into a task list with owners and due dates. Or: check every client proposal against our pricing rules. Or: my onboarding skill skips the contract step, fix it.
request.context: Describe it the way you'd explain it to a colleague: what goes in, what should come out, and any rules it must follow. Name the tools or apps it should work with, if any. No technical terms needed.

audience.label: Who Will Use It
audience.context: Decides how it reaches people: a file you upload yourself, a file or private marketplace for a team, or an organization-wide rollout by an admin.
audience.options:
Just Me
My Team
My Whole Organization
Not sure yet

surface.label: Where They Use Claude
surface.context: Not sure is fine. AI Extender then builds something that loads everywhere.
surface.options:
Claude Code
Cowork (Claude Desktop App)
Claude.ai chat
Not Sure

files.label: Files
files.context: For an update, fix, or check, point to the existing skill or plugin. For a new build, attach any checklist, template, or example output it should follow.
files.options:
Attached in This Message
In the Claude Project Files
Created Earlier in This Chat
None, Start from Scratch
